scripts.demo: BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay pnpm build && BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay concurrently -n web,worker "next start" "tsx scripts/worker.ts"
scripts.db:reset: rm -f data/blink.db data/blink.db-wal data/blink.db-shm && mkdir -p data && drizzle-kit migrate && tsx scripts/seed.ts && BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay tsx scripts/eval.ts --quiet
scripts.db:reset:dev: rm -f data/blink.db data/blink.db-wal data/blink.db-shm && mkdir -p data && drizzle-kit migrate && tsx scripts/seed.ts --manual-policy --gold && BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay tsx scripts/eval.ts --quiet
scripts.e2e:serve: BLINK_DB_PATH=./data/e2e.db BLINK_LLM_MODE=replay sh -c 'rm -f data/e2e.db data/e2e.db-wal data/e2e.db-shm && mkdir -p data && drizzle-kit migrate && tsx scripts/seed.ts && tsx scripts/eval.ts --quiet && next build && concurrently -k -n web,worker "next start -p 3100" "tsx scripts/worker.ts"'
